neighbours.label: the word 'reduce' in any form or language (reduce, reduced, reducing, reduction, réduire), firing most where something is reduced to a smaller amount, size or simpler state; not synonyms such as cut, lower, shrink or decrease
fire: Simmer the sauce until it is reduced by half and coats the spoon.
The new insulation helped us reduce our heating bill by thirty percent.
After the storm, the old barn was reduced to a pile of splintered boards.
The company announced a sharp reduction in its workforce last spring.
Le gouvernement veut réduire la consommation d'énergie de dix pour cent.
Doctors advised him to reduce his salt intake.
Prices were reduced for the end-of-season sale.
quiet: Simmer the sauce until it thickens and coats the spoon.
The new insulation helped us lower our heating bill by thirty percent.
After the storm, the old barn was left as a pile of splintered boards.
The company announced sharp cuts to its workforce last spring.
Le gouvernement veut baisser la consommation d'énergie de dix pour cent.
Doctors advised him to cut back on salt.
Prices were slashed for the end-of-season sale.

predictions: Near misses all low (synonyms stayed under 0.05 in probing); risk is the median: abstract 'reduce the risk'-style uses probed ~0.1, concrete 'reduced to/by' uses 0.4-0.9.
